text: Program Description Cardiovascular Medicinecontains a disease of the content of the definition, etiology, pathogenesis, epidemiology, natural history, symptoms, signs, laboratory diagnosis, imaging examination, differential diagnosis, diagnosis, treatment and prognosis. Internal medicine is through history or after the interview, physical examination, according to the history and examination experiment diagnosis and imaging, many in the differential diagnosis lower exclude the possibility that the most likely diagnosis is available; After diagnosis, medical treatment includes tracking observation, life style, drug, interventional therapy (such as cardiac catheterization, endoscopic), adjust the use of a drug according to the patient's condition, prevent and treatment side effects and complications. Duration 3 years
